On a steady block we read your long message, and the cargo liaison looked into it. We understand that your complaint concerns the handling of your companion animal travel arrangements and the concern that the care promised at booking did not fully match the experience you received. Please accept our sincere apology for the distress this caused, as we know that travel with an animal depends on clear communication, calm support, and careful preparation at every stage.

The Companion Animal Travel Desk takes these matters seriously and reviews each report with the booking notes, the boarding instructions, and the handoff records used by our welcome team. In situations such as yours, we check whether the reservation details were properly shared, whether the pet care guidance was followed, and whether the passenger received the support expected before departure and at pickup. If any part of that process fell short, we will address it directly with the teams involved and reinforce the standards that Aurelia Skyways requires.

We also want to assure you that our goal is not only to respond after a concern is raised, but to prevent the same difficulty from affecting another traveler. Our staff is trained to keep communication warm, professional, and consistent from the first booking note through the final collection of the animal. When a traveler is left uncertain, that is not the experience we intend to provide, and we regret that this happened in your case.

If you would like us to continue the review, we remain ready to examine the file further and to confirm what steps were taken on your behalf. We appreciate the opportunity to restore your confidence in the Companion Animal Travel Desk and in the care standards maintained by Aurelia Skyways.

We value your patience and will continue working toward a fair resolution.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
